# CLI: Monitor

## get-dashboard

Kind: Read.

Reads one dashboard without widgets. There is no delete command.

| Flag             | Type     | Required |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--dashboard-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-dashboard --dashboard-id <dashboard-id> --query Dashboard
```

## list-check-response-times

Kind: Read.

HTTP checks only. --start and --end are RFC 3339. --end defaults to now and
--start to 24 hours before --end. The window is at most 24 hours. Values are
average response times in milliseconds per probe location, in 5-minute buckets
for a 24-hour window. Use get-check-alarm for location names.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--check-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--start`    | `string` |          |
| `--end`      | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor list-check-response-times --check-id <check-id>
```

## list-dashboards

Kind: Read.

Lists custom dashboards by default. --system lists dashboards GreenNode
generates per resource. The read omits widgets. There is no delete command.

| Flag       | Type   | Required |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- |
| `--page`   | `int`  |          |
| `--size`   | `int`  |          |
| `--system` | `bool` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor list-dashboards
```

## list-synthetic-packages

Kind: Read.

Lists class options, class unit packages, and v1 packages separately, with their
own identifiers. Class Packages shows unit API, location, tier, and monthly unit
price. Options join only by exact package ID within the class. The v1 catalog
cannot establish class option prices. Disabled classes stay visible.
AutoRenewEligible is unknown without provider evidence. Settings periods are
shown separately. Known free periods are capped by the free maximum. Read-only
settings allow this read.

No fields.

```sh
greennode monitor list-synthetic-packages
```

## quota-status

Kind: Read.

--kind optionally selects synthetic, email, or sms, case insensitively. Omitted
means all three. Returns a sequential snapshot with one UTC AsOf. Synthetic uses
quota, detail, class catalog, and settings reads, with detail price and class
and an unknown package name. Notification price is the current list price.
Missing quotas produce none rows and exit 0. Failed rows print partial output,
ignore --query, and exit 1 as QuotaStatusIncomplete. Null means unknown. False
and zero remain distinct. RenewWindowOpen describes the catalog-eligible free
Synthetic timing window. NextSafeCommand suggests renewal inside the free window
or recovery for expired free trash, only with POC and auto-renew off. Suggested
writes require explicit guards from a fresh read. Table and text show time left
in days, hours, and minutes. Rows without errors have a blank Error cell.
Read-only settings allow this read.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quota-status --kind synthetic
```
